title: BODY
summary: Makes a sound fuller and wider, while the deep bass stays clean and centered.
steps: Add BODY to a bass, a lead or a pad.
Drive adds thickness; Color says where it sits (low = warm, high = bright).
Width spreads the sound left and right.
Below 150 Hz nothing changes, and the level stays the same.

examples.title: Fat mids on a bass
examples.text: The bass top gets thicker; the sub is untouched.

examples.title: A wide pad
examples.text: The pad opens wide around you.

examples.title: An edge on a lead
examples.text: A brighter, harder edge for fast leads.
